description: Defines helper classes for managing audio sink frame buffers and environment for testing purposes, including classes AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers and AudioSinkTestEnvironment with methods for handling audio frames, sink validation, and callback synchronization.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers
classes.description: Manages audio frame buffers with support for different sample and storage types.

classes.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
classes.description: Manages an SbAudioSink instance for testing, including control over playback state and synchronization.

methods.name: AudioSinkTestFrameBuffers
methods.description: Constructs frame buffers with specified channels, sample type, and storage type.

methods.name: sample_type
methods.description: Returns the sample type used in the frame buffers.

methods.name: storage_type
methods.description: Returns the storage type used in the frame buffers.

methods.name: channels
methods.description: Returns the number of channels.

methods.name: bytes_per_frame
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per audio frame based on sample type.

methods.name: frames_per_channel
methods.description: Returns the number of frames per channel.

methods.name: frame_buffers
methods.description: Returns pointer to the array of frame buffers.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes internal buffer structures.

methods.name: AudioSinkTestEnvironment
methods.description: Constructor for setting up the test environment with specified frame buffers.

methods.name: ~AudioSinkTestEnvironment
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the test environment.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the audio sink is valid.

methods.name: sample_rate
methods.description: Returns the nearest supported sample rate.

methods.name: SetIsPlaying
methods.description: Sets the playing state of the sink.

methods.name: AppendFrame
methods.description: Appends frames to the sink.

methods.name: GetFrameBufferFreeSpaceInFrames
methods.description: Returns free space in frames in the buffer.

methods.name: WaitUntilUpdateStatusCalled
methods.description: Waits until update status callback is called.

methods.name: WaitUntilSomeFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until some frames are consumed.

methods.name: WaitUntilAllFramesAreConsumed
methods.description: Waits until all frames are consumed.

methods.name: AppendFrame_Locked
methods.description: Appends frames with thread safety.

methods.name: GetFrameBufferFreeSpaceInFrames_Locked
methods.description: Thread-safe retrieval of free buffer space.

methods.name: OnUpdateSourceStatus
methods.description: Handles source status updates.

methods.name: OnConsumeFrames
methods.description: Handles frame consumption.

methods.name: UpdateSourceStatusFunc
methods.description: Static callback for source status updates.

methods.name: ConsumeFramesFunc
methods.description: Static callback for consuming frames.
